description: This file contains utility functions and types for launching and managing child processes, including process cleanup, signal handling, and process termination logic within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: gracefullyCloseAll
methods.description: Closes all processes in the gracefullyCloseSet set gracefully.

methods.name: gracefullyProcessExitDoNotHang
methods.description: Exits the process after attempting to gracefully close all processes, with a forced exit after 30 seconds.

methods.name: launchProcess
methods.description: Launches a child process with specified options, manages its lifecycle, and provides methods for graceful shutdown and killing.

methods.name: envArrayToObject
methods.description: Converts an array of environment variable objects to a key-value object.
